evidence_displayed: StackedBarRenderer::findRangeBounds, StackedAreaRenderer::getStackValues, StackedBarRenderer3D::createStackedValueList: grep call-site lines only, bodies never displayed
rationale: All three premises verify against the patch: the test adds NaN and expects lower bound 2.0; findStackedRangeBounds is now a null check plus delegation to extentOfCategories; signedSums uses 'if (v > 0.0) ... else below += v', so NaN enters the negative total (the original used a separate value<0.0 test, which the displayed sibling findMinimumStackedRangeValue still shows). The agent's own chain places the first wrong value at signedSums, which also violates its javadoc ('negative values ... summed separately'). It nonetheless ranked the one-line facade first solely because it is 'the public production method under test' and 'the primary repair location'. The rank-1 body contains no fault; its altered javadoc is non-causal on the trigger input and was not cited.
